name: 07 Journal — Masthead, cover story, and category filtering

planSteps.description: Navigate to /index.html?page=journal and wait for stories to load
Verify the masthead displays THE JOURNAL and the story count shows '05 STORIES'
Verify the story count updates to '01 STORY'
Click the filter button for 'All stories'
Verify the story count returns to '05 STORIES'
